faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse - III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse - III recruitment is 10 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse - III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a Four-year Nursing Course to be eligible for the Project Nurse - III position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Nurse - III post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse - III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse - III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Nurse - III position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse - III recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Nurse - III post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Nurse - III position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.
